title: Rahul Gandhi Alleges PM Modi's Popularity Amongst Youth Threatens Him
summary: Rahul Gandhi, the Congress leader, has alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's popularity among the youth threatens him. This comes after Piyush Goyal, Union Minister and BJP spokesperson, stated that Rahul feels threatened by PM Modi's popularity amongst the youth. The allegations were made in a press conference held on [date] at [location]. According to Piyush Goyal, Congress is facing a crisis due to its inability to connect with the younger generation. Rahul Gandhi has been trying to reach out to the youth through various initiatives, but his efforts have been unsuccessful. The situation has become so dire that Rahul feels threatened by PM Modi's popularity amongst the youth.
summary_points: Rahul Gandhi alleged that PM Modi's popularity among the youth threatens him
Piyush Goyal stated that Rahul feels threatened by PM Modi's popularity amongst the youth
Congress is facing a crisis due to its inability to connect with the younger generation
Rahul Gandhi has been trying to reach out to the youth through various initiatives
PM Modi's popularity among the youth has become a significant concern for Congress
title_hi: राहुल गांधी ने पीएम मोदी की युवाओं की लोकप्रियता से डरने का दावा किया
summary_hi: कांग्रेस नेता राहुल गांधी ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की युवाओं की लोकप्रियता से डरने का दावा किया है। यह बात पीयूष गoyal, भाजपा स्पokesperson और केंद्रीय मंत्री, ने कही है कि राहुल गांधी पीएम मोदी की लोकप्रियता के कारण डर रहे हैं। कांग्रेस को युवाओं के साथ जुड़ने में असमर्थता के कारण यह स्थिति उत्पन्न हुई है। राहुल गांधी ने विभिन्न पहलों के माध्यम से युवाओं तक पहुंचने का प्रयास किया है, लेकिन उनके प्रयास असफल रहे। इस स्थिति ने राहुल को पीएम मोदी की लोकप्रियता के कारण डरने का एहसास दिलाया है।
